title: Ontology Entity Class Fields
description: Reusable ontology fields injected into every entity type

entityClass.description: Provider-agnostic class from the cyber ontology taxonomy

entityCategory.description: Top-level category group in the taxonomy

ontologyVersion.description: Version of the ontology spec this entity conforms to

assemblyLevel.description: Position in the system-of-systems hierarchy. 0 = atom (smallest unit), 4 = system of systems (highest assembly).

assemblyContext.description: Human-readable explanation of why this entity is at this assembly level in this particular boundary context.

atomicChildren.description: IDs of entities at assemblyLevel N-1 that this entity is assembled from. Null for atoms (level 0).

assembledInto.description: ID of the entity at assemblyLevel N+1 that this entity is part of. Null for top-level systems of systems.
